jobs.title: Technical Accountant
jobs.description:
What We're Up To
Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has over 1,900 markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.


We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.



- Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. 
- Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. 

Building a new category is hard… like, really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.


Role Roadmap
We’re looking for a seasoned, detail-oriented Technical Accountant to serve as a trusted expert on complex accounting issues and emerging business initiatives. You’ll lead the Company’s interpretation and application of U.S. GAAP, partner cross-functionally on high-impact projects, and ensure technical conclusions are accurate, well-reasoned, and thoroughly documented. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of accounting, strategy, and regulatory evolution, and who’s passionate about shaping accounting policy in a fast-growing environment.


Key Responsibilities
Technical Accounting Leadership



- Lead the accounting evaluation for complex and emerging business initiatives, collaborating across teams to identify, assess, and resolve technical issues
- 
Develop well-supported conclusions and high-quality technical memos that stand up to audit and regulatory scrutiny



- 
Serve as a primary liaison with external auditors on technical matters, ensuring transparency and constructive dialogue




Accounting Standards & Policy



- 
Monitor and interpret new accounting guidance from the FASB and other standard-setting bodies, evaluating potential impacts on financial statements



- 
Lead implementation efforts for new standards and ensure consistent application across teams



- 
Develop, document, and maintain company-wide accounting policies, updating them as business operations and regulations evolve




Cross-Functional Partnership & Projects



- 
Partner with Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Operations to ensure accounting considerations are integrated into business decisions



- 
Support strategic initiatives and special projects, proactively identifying and addressing accounting implications.



- 
Drive continuous improvement in accounting processes, documentation, and internal controls




Qualifications

- 
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting and active CPA (or equivalent certification)



- 
5+ years of experience in public accounting (Big 4 preferred) and/or technical accounting roles



- 
Strong preference for experience in financial exchanges, clearing organizations, broker-dealers/FCMs, fintech, or high-growth technology environments



- 
Deep knowledge of U.S. GAAP and ability to interpret, apply, and communicate evolving guidance across varied topics



- 
Proven success influencing cross-functional teams and driving alignment across Accounting, Legal, Finance, and Compliance



- 
Analytical, structured thinker with exceptional attention to detail and strong written and verbal communication skills



- 
A lifelong learner passionate about technical accounting, regulatory change, and continuous improvement




Our Culture
Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.


Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.


NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure:
Salary Range: $100,000 to $180,000 annually plus equity and benefits.
This salary range is based on the current available market data, and represents the expected salary range for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and few titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles. Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to further discuss.


Commitment to Equal Opportunity
Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Navan is looking for a travel specialist to partner with our US Enterprise sales team. We are looking for someone who is capable of influencing prospects, building strong relationships and supporting Account Executives in the close of complex, net new deals.

As a member of this team, you will need to be an expert on the corporate travel industry and Navan platform. You will be responsible for demoing the platform and application, pitching our value proposition to customer travel and program managers, conducting strategy sessions with account executives and sales leaders, producing business value assessments for prospects, along with other required travel evaluation related steps during the discovery and scope of new business opportunities. Additionally, the role will provide a platform for candidates to enable new Account Executives, and to provide feedback to our product and operations teams, as we continue to scale rapidly. Strong desire to succeed, effective communication, and internal/external collaboration are key skills in achieving success in this role, along with adaptability.

What You'll Do:

- Partner with the AE and Sales Leader to develop strategies for new business opportunities within your assigned territory
- Qualify opportunities with our Lean, Pivot, Walk methodology, and help account executives move opportunities through their pipeline to close
- Support AE's in learning Navan solution, demoing the platform, and providing them with competitive insights
- Pitch Navan value proposition and solution to travel managers, framing our solution for their pain points and the value drivers they care most about
- Interface with multiple personas within target organizations, especially those with deep travel industry experience
- Articulate Navan’ products and services, helping to scope fit for large, complex organizations
- Help grow sales for the team you are supporting, exceeding the monthly and quarterly sales quotas
- Run proof of concepts to expedite evaluation process;

- User Access Testing
- Workshops (finance, IT, Sustainability, etc.)
- Business Value Assessment

What We're Looking For:

- 4-5+ years of experience selling for a TMC, OBT or other travel industry technology, in a full-cycle closing role; or comparable experience as a consultant or managing a global travel program
- 1-2+ years of selling to travel managers in enterprise sized businesses (+3,000 employees), or working as a travel manager at an Enterprise-sized company
- Strong written and verbal communication, as well as quantitative analysis skills
- Experience conducting product demonstrations
- Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, Command of the Message, preferred, but not required
- Consistent track record of producing successful outcomes in a fast-paced environment
- High adaptability and understanding of change within the evolution of a startup
- Growth mindset: an ability and desire to learn and pivot use of skill sets based on business needs

The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity.

For roles with on-target-earnings (OTE), the pay range includes both base salary and target incentive compensation. Target incentive compensation for some roles may include a ramping draw period. Compensation is higher for those who exceed targets. Candidates may receive more information from the recruiter.

Pay Range

$172,800—$216,000 USD

Human oversight: Metaview does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our recruiters and hiring managers review all outputs and make the final hiring decision regarding every application.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Curated Data
jobs.description:
About Dune

Dune's mission is to make onchain finance observable. We're the industry standard for onchain data: a blockchain data and intelligence provider that institutions, protocols, and analysts trust to understand the onchain world and the frontiers of finance. We deliver structured datasets, spanning stablecoins, RWAs, tokens, lending, trading, and more, from 130+ chains and counting, to 1,000+ industry leaders including Visa, WisdomTree, FINRA, the IMF, Bloomberg, Standard Chartered, Coinbase, Forbes, and the Financial Times.

We're a tight knit team of ~50 hard working people, spread across Europe and eastern US timezones ️, having an outsized impact on the industry. We take pride in being ambitious and doing world class work while staying humble and lighthearted. We believe in building open, verifiable data that lets individuals and institutions do deep research into ecosystems like Ethereum, Solana, Robinhood and many more.

We're backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that let us double down on our mission.

If you like being challenged and want to work together with a brilliant team on an important mission, come join us.

Learn more about us:

Dune's Vision

https://dune.com/blog/dune-vision

Values and working at Dune

https://dune.com/careers

About the role
Data Products builds and owns datasets end to end: from raw chain data through decoding to the 3000+ models and 4 petabytes we curate, share directly with customers, and replicate into their warehouses.

The role will focus on the lifecycle of building high quality data: orchestrating thousands of interdependent models, propagating schema changes without breaking downstream consumers, propagating corrections.
That is a software architecture problem in a data domain. This role is a hybrid: a backend engineer who thinks in systems and contracts, working on data.

You will be the engineer we hand ambiguous product requirements to, and will come back with a design, a sequence, and work the team can pick up, while building the hardest parts yourself.

In this role you will

-
Design and build the control plane for our curated data lifecycle: dependency-aware orchestration, backfills, restatements, retries, partial failure, and recovery

-
Decide, dataset by dataset, whether the answer is a model, a service or a job, and own that architecture through production

-
Design the contracts between ingestion and curation so a dataset can be reasoned about end to end

-
Build alerting and data quality signals that catch real problems and stay quiet otherwise, so on-call is about incidents rather than noise

-
Work across Go, Kotlin, Rust, Python and SQL, choosing the right tool rather than the familiar one

-
Break large problems into work other engineers can own, and sequence it so we ship something useful early

You might be a great fit if

-
You are a backend engineer who has gone deep on data systems, or a data engineer who became a strong software engineer. You ship production services, not only pipelines

-
You have built or materially extended orchestration and scheduling systems, and can explain precisely what breaks at scale and why

-
You have handled schema evolution and data correctness in a system with real consumers downstream, where a breaking change has a cost

-
You have built or operated stateful stream processing in production (Flink,Kafka Streams, Spark Structured Streaming, RisingWave, Materialize, Feldera)

-
You have strong SQL and modeling skills on large datasets, and an interest in how the query engine underneath actually executes your work

-
You have solid computer science fundamentals and distributed systems understanding

-
You debug independently and drive root cause analysis to a fix that holds

-
You use AI tools well enough that they have changed how you work, you understand their failure modes and dislike ai-slop.

-
You communicate clearly in writing and get the best out of a distributed team

Not required, but a plus

-
Deep experience with a transformation framework such as dbt or SQLMesh: specifically, having hit its limits and built beyond them

-
Data lake formats such as Parquet, Iceberg or Deltalog

-
Stateful stream processing in production (Flink, Kafka Streams, Spark Structured Streaming)

-
Experience at a company where the data is the product

Perks & Benefits

-
A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

-
Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

-
5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you)

-
A fully remote-first approach ‍ within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day

-
Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

-
Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard

-
We believe in paid parental leave  to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

-
Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany  Berlin  Austria  and Athens ).

-
On top of this each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

-
An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

-
Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

-
And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: AI Operations Lead, Toast IQ
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

About the Role:

Toast IQ is our agentic platform for local business: a growing set of specialized AI agents and capabilities designed to take real work off an operator’s plate, from driving demand and managing labor to optimizing the back office. As we expand this portfolio across multiple lines of business, we need to ensure that what we build comes together as a coherent platform, reaches the market effectively, and produces meaningful customer and business impact.

The AI Operations Lead will help build and run the operating system that connects AI strategy to execution and market impact. You will help shape how our AI portfolio comes together, is launched, and adopted, building the operating engine that brings this experience to life, and turning customer, market, and technology signals into better product and commercial decisions.

This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on leadership role. You will work directly with the VP of Product for Toast IQ, partnering across product, design, engineering, marketing, sales, and support to bring the vision of Toast IQ to life. Success will require strong judgment, exceptional communication, and the ability to personally drive ambiguous work to completion.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

- Create visibility across Toast’s broader AI efforts and run portfolio ops. Connect work happening across the agent portfolio and other AI initiatives. Share learnings, identify opportunities to reuse capabilities, and surface key decisions. Maintain visibility into ownership, sequencing, dependencies, key decisions, risks, progress, and enablement.
- Build Toast’s AI presence. Partner with product, design, engineering, and marketing to make Toast’s AI products, technical insights, customer outcomes, and talent more visible through launches, customer stories, product and engineering content, and social channels both internally and externally.
- Turn high-impact ideas into action. Identify opportunities to accelerate Toast’s AI strategy, develop a strong point of view on what we should do, and have the ownership to run at the best ideas, bringing the right people together and driving the work from concept to tangible outcome
- Help shape the AI portfolio strategy. Partner with product and business leaders to define target customers, priority use cases, positioning, packaging, sequencing, and launch plans across Toast’s AI portfolio.
- Build an AI-powered engine that gets smarter over time. Use AI to continuously synthesize customer insights, product performance, market shifts, and changes in the underlying technology, turning signals from across the business into actions that improve our products, priorities, and how we bring them to customers.
- Turn a fast-moving AI market into an advantage. Stay up on what’s happening in AI and help translate emerging patterns into implications for Toast’s strategy

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

- Fluent with AI products, including how they work and what patterns are leading within B2B and consumer markets.
- 5+ years of experience in product operations, business operations, go-to-market strategy, or product marketing, with experience working alongside product and engineering teams.
- Demonstrated ownership of complex or emerging products from development through launch, internal enablement, customer adoption, and ongoing market learning.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex information into a clear narrative for customers, go-to-market teams, and senior leaders.
- Track record of building repeatable, cross-functional operating models.
- Strong product and commercial judgment, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into clear customer value and compelling market narratives.
- Ability to move fluidly between strategy and execution, from shaping a portfolio narrative or launch plan to improving a demo, creating enablement, resolving a readiness gap, or synthesizing customer feedback.
- Strong analytical skills and experience defining the measures that indicate whether a launch is working.
- High judgment and comfort operating in ambiguity. You recognize what matters, make defensible decisions, surface the right questions, and personally drive work to completion

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

- Experience bringing AI/ML, agentic, platform, or other rapidly evolving technical products to market.
- Experience building a launch, commercialization, or adoption motion.
- Experience in a startup or high-growth environment where the role required significant range and adaptability.
- Experience developing customer proof, product demonstrations, or technical thought leadership.
- Vertical SaaS, SMB, or restaurant and hospitality technology experience.
- Familiarity with AI product evaluation and the commercial considerations associated with AI products.
- BA/BS or equivalent practical experience

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

jobs.title: Sr Global Events Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

The Sr. Global Marketing Event Specialist will be responsible for all aspects of organizing, managing, strategizing, and overseeing virtual and in-person, internal, user conferences and events. This individual will plan, execute, research, measure and work cross-team. The Sr. Global Marketing Event Specialist will create programs that align with Instructure’s strategic initiatives to drive customer advocacy, adoption, retention and expansion through Instructure’s global events.

The Sr. Global Marketing Event Specialist will serve as the company expert in the areas of standard concepts, practices, and procedures. In coordination with the Director of Events they will also be responsible for creating a plan and budget for their area of expertise.

This position is a fully remote position with travel to the main office in Salt Lake as well as to each event during the year.

Responsibilities

-
Support strategic development of marketing event programs that reinforce the Instructure brand, develop qualified leads, strengthen and expand customer relations

-
Oversee all aspects of program and event execution for both internal and external programs such as user conferences, employee events, trade shows, special events and other programs related to marketing initiatives.

-
Strategizes and coordinates all event communication and messaging

-
Coordinates detailed event logistics

-
Develops scalable processes for their area of expertise

-
Evaluates and reports on KPI's

-
Monitors event budgets and assists with the negotiation of all necessary contracts

-
Researches and assists contracts for all necessary speakers and entertainers

-
Communicates key event information to the organization

-
Monitors and manages expenses associated with each event

-
Responsible for post-event analysis, and lead conversion reports ensures that proper personnel have been scheduled to adequately work the events

-
Works with internal and external teams to develop event agenda based of company strategy and customer needs

-
Sets communication strategy for the event segmentation lists

-
Assist in the development and regular reporting of meaningful metrics that help improve the efficiency of the events and sponsorships function and demonstrate the value of Instructure’s investments in marketing events

-
Oversee vendor selection process and evaluate vendor relationships for their service quality, value, and cost effectiveness

jobs.title: Payments Lead
jobs.description:
Kalshi is defining a new category
Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

- Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.
- Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Building a new category is hard… like really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

About the Role
As Payments Lead, you’ll own the full lifecycle of payments at Kalshi — from strategy to hands-on execution. You’ll manage and coordinate the roadmap for deposits, withdrawals, and PSP integrations, while also directly managing providers, resolving issues, and monitoring day-to-day performance. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, operations, engineering, compliance, and growth, ensuring that payments are reliable, fast, and delightful.

What You’ll Do
Key Responsibilities

- Lead the payments roadmap: prioritize and drive initiatives that improve payment success, speed, and user experience in coordination with Engineering and Growth and other parts of the organization.

- Manage PSPs and financial partners: negotiate terms, oversee performance, and troubleshoot operational issues with processors, banks, and other partners.

- Optimize conversion and payouts: continuously improve the deposit and withdrawal experience, authorization rates, and settlement times through data-driven experimentation.

- Monitor and analyze payment health: build dashboards, track KPIs (authorization rates, declines, chargebacks, latency), and identify root causes.

- Ensure compliance and regulatory alignment: Partner with Legal/Compliance to handle KYC, AML, and CFTC-related obligations in the payments flow.

- Manage fraud prevention and response: manage fraud tools and policies, ensuring a balance between risk control and user experience. Monitor fraud and compliance health.

- Be hands-on: dive into payment ops workflows, test new integrations, reconcile issues, and own execution when needed.

What We’re Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in payments, fintech, or product operations.

- Strong understanding of the payments ecosystem: PSPs, acquirers, processors, payment methods, fraud tools, and settlement processes.

- Experience leading cross-functional projects involving engineering, compliance, and growth.

- Proven negotiation and vendor management skills with PSPs and banks.

- Analytical and technical proficiency: able to model economics, analyze funnel data, and interpret API documentation.

- Bias toward action: comfortable switching between strategic planning and hands-on execution.

- Excellent communication and project management skills.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity
Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: CPH - Provider Engagement
jobs.description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient outcomes through Counterpart Assistant, our innovative primary care technology. By empowering primary care physicians with actionable clinical insights, we help practices identify disease earlier, manage chronic conditions longitudinally, and deliver higher-quality care at a lower cost.

We are seeking a Senior Provider Success Manager to serve as a strategic advisor to primary care organizations in New Jersey using Counterpart Assistant. This individual will own the success of a complex portfolio of provider partnerships and lead the strategies that drive sustained adoption, measurable performance improvement, expansion, and long-term retention.

This is a senior, results-oriented, provider-facing role for someone who can influence clinical and operational leaders, guide practices through meaningful workflow transformation, and connect product utilization to value-based care outcomes. The Senior Provider Success Manager will operate as an external product and industry expert while also representing the provider voice across Counterpart Health.

Beyond managing individual partnerships, this person will identify patterns across the market, develop scalable provider-success strategies, and mentor colleagues on effective engagement and change-management practices. The role requires strong judgment, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the ability to lead complex initiatives without direct authority.

Candidates must reside currently reside in New Jersey and be willing to travel to provider practices up to 85% of the time.

What You’ll Do
Own the strategy and performance of a complex provider portfolio

- Develop and execute success strategies for a portfolio of high-priority or operationally complex primary care partnerships.
- Establish shared clinical, operational, and business objectives with provider and practice leaders.
- Maintain a comprehensive view of portfolio performance, including adoption, engagement, provider satisfaction, clinical opportunities, retention risks, and expansion potential.
- Anticipate barriers and intervene early to protect partner value and long-term account health.
- Lead business and performance reviews that translate data into clear priorities, decisions, and commitments.

Advise clinical and operational leaders

- Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice clinicians, practice administrators, and executive stakeholders.
- Serve as a strategic advisor on incorporating Counterpart Assistant into clinical decision-making and value-based care operations.
- Tailor recommendations to each organization’s workflows, patient population, staffing model, technology environment, and performance goals.
- Influence stakeholders with different priorities and levels of technical or clinical expertise.
- Lead sensitive conversations involving performance gaps, resistance to change, competing priorities, and partnership risk.

Lead adoption and clinical workflow transformation

- Diagnose complex workflow challenges and design practical solutions that embed Counterpart Assistant into daily clinical operations.
- Guide practices through implementation, change management, training, workflow redesign, and ongoing optimization on behalf of multiple customers.
- Establish adoption plans with clear milestones, ownership, success measures, and escalation paths.
- Identify opportunities to improve clinical and administrative processes across diverse primary care environments.
- Ensure that adoption translates into sustained behavior change and measurable provider and patient value.

Drive measurable provider performance

- Analyze utilization, operational, clinical, and financial data to identify trends, risks, and performance opportunities.
- Delivery actionable scorecards and recommendations that help providers improve value-based care outcomes.
- Lead targeted interventions for underperforming practices and evaluate their impact.

Shape regional multi-customer provider-success strategy

- Identify recurring provider needs and convert successful approaches into scalable playbooks, tools, and engagement models.
- Lead cross-portfolio initiatives that improve implementation quality, adoption, retention, or provider experience.
- Establish and promote provider-success best practices across markets and practice types.
- Use market insights and provider feedback to recommend improvements to Counterpart Health’s product, operating model, and go-to-market strategy.
- Represent Provider Success in strategic cross-functional initiatives and planning discussions.

Partner across Counterpart Health

- Collaborate with Growth, Implementation, Clinical, Product, Analytics, and Operations teams to deliver a coordinated provider experience.
- Support high-value provider recruitment and expansion opportunities as a product, workflow, and value-based care expert.
- Translate provider feedback into structured insights that inform product priorities and operational decisions.
- Lead resolution of complex escalations by aligning internal teams around root causes, owners, and action plans.
- Mentor Provider Success colleagues and contribute to the development of team standards, tools, and capabilities.

What Success Looks Like

- Provider and practice leaders view you as a credible strategic partner who understands their clinical, operational, and financial priorities.
- Your portfolio consistently achieves agreed adoption, engagement, retention, and performance targets.
- Counterpart Assistant is integrated into providers’ daily workflows and used to support clinical decision-making—not treated as an optional or stand-alone tool.
- You identify portfolio risks early and lead coordinated interventions that restore performance and strengthen partnerships.
- Providers can clearly articulate how Counterpart Assistant supports better patient care and success in value-based arrangements.
- Your performance recommendations lead to observable changes in provider behavior, workflow execution, and relevant clinical or financial outcomes.
- Your insights influence product enhancements, operating decisions, and provider-success strategy beyond your assigned portfolio.
- Colleagues seek your guidance on complex provider situations, stakeholder management, and workflow transformation.

You Should Get in Touch If

- You have 7–10+ years of experience in provider success, healthcare account management, clinical operations, practice transformation, value-based care consulting, or a related field.
- You have managed complex or high-value provider relationships and can demonstrate success improving adoption, retention, satisfaction, and performance.
- You have experience advising physicians, practice administrators, and healthcare leaders.
- You have led significant changes to clinical or operational workflows in primary care or ambulatory care settings.
- You can translate complex clinical, operational, and financial data into clear recommendations, performance plans, and executive-level narratives.
- You understand how primary care organizations operate, including the competing demands placed on clinicians and practice staff.
- You are comfortable leading through influence, resolving ambiguity, and coordinating stakeholders without direct authority.
- You have strong program and project leadership skills and can manage multiple high-priority initiatives while maintaining accountability for outcomes.
- You communicate effectively in provider meetings, performance reviews, product demonstrations, and challenging escalation conversations.
- You are willing to travel up to 75% of the time to build relationships and support provider practices.

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep knowledge of value-based care, Medicare Advantage, population health, or quality-improvement models.
- Experience implementing healthcare technology within primary care environments.
- Familiarity with electronic health records, interoperability, medical billing, reimbursement, and risk-based payment arrangements.
- Knowledge of annual wellness visits, risk adjustment and coding accuracy, Stars, HEDIS, and other quality-performance frameworks.
- Experience designing provider-success playbooks, segmentation models, engagement programs, or performance-management processes.
- Experience mentoring colleagues or serving as a subject-matter expert within a provider-facing organization.

Benefits Overview:

- Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
- Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
- Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
- Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
- Reimbursement for office setup expenses
- Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
- Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
- Paid parental leave for all new parents
- And much more!

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

jobs.title: Chief Actuary
jobs.description:
The Finance team at Clover Health is a group of strategic partners providing financial and operational insights that drive informed decision-making and efficient capital allocation. Guided by our core values of excellence, accountability, and collaboration, we provide actionable recommendations to improve health outcomes and reduce costs while ensuring financial integrity and innovation.

Actuarial is at the center of some of Clover's most important decisions—from pricing and forecasting to reserving, medical economics, and long-term strategy. As Chief Actuary, you'll lead and evolve this function during a pivotal stage of the company's growth, helping shape how we deploy AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve decision-making across the business.

This isn't a traditional Chief Actuary role. We're looking for someone who can combine deep actuarial expertise with modern technology, building AI-enabled workflows that transform how actuarial work gets done while maintaining the rigor, transparency, and governance required in a highly regulated environment. You'll partner closely with leaders across Finance, Clinical, Growth, Operations, and Product to influence company strategy while building a best-in-class actuarial organization.

As a Chief Actuary, you will:

- Lead Clover's enterprise actuarial function, including pricing, forecasting, reserving, medical economics, Part D, Stars analytics, and bid strategy.
- Establish the long-term vision for actuarial, modernizing the function through AI, automation, and scalable analytical infrastructure.
-  Build AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort, accelerate insight generation, and improve actuarial decision-making while ensuring explainability, governance, and regulatory compliance.
- Lead the annual Medicare Advantage bid strategy and pricing process, framing tradeoffs among growth, competitiveness, margin, risk, and capital requirements to support enterprise planning and executive decision-making.
- Assume responsibility for actuarial opinions, reserve adequacy, and related regulatory actuarial requirements, including transitioning responsibilities currently supported by external actuarial partners.
- Guide reserving methodology, IBNR development, forecasting, and emerging experience analysis to provide timely, reliable financial insights.
- Partner with Finance leadership to strengthen forecasting, planning, capital management, and enterprise performance measurement.
- Collaborate with Medical Economics to identify healthcare cost trends, evaluate interventions, and develop strategies that improve member outcomes while managing medical expense.
-  Drive adoption of modern analytics tools and AI capabilities across the actuarial organization, helping the team operate faster, smarter, and with greater transparency.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating complex actuarial concepts into clear business recommendations.
- Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing actuarial organization, including organizational design, performance management, workforce capacity, and development of actuarial and analytical talent.
- Build strong partnerships across Finance, Clinical, Operations, Growth, Data Science, and Engineering to ensure actuarial insights are embedded in strategic decision-making.
- Establish and maintain actuarial governance, model review, documentation, control, and validation standards that support regulatory compliance, financial integrity, and sound executive decision-making.

Success in this role looks like:

First 90 Days

- Build trusted relationships across Finance and key business partners.
-  Assess the current actuarial organization, tools, and operating model.
- Develop a roadmap for AI adoption and workflow automation across the actuarial function.
- Gain deep familiarity with Clover's pricing, forecasting, reserving, and medical economics processes.

First 6 Months

- Begin implementing AI-enabled actuarial workflows that improve efficiency and insight generation.
- Strengthen forecasting, reserving, and bid processes through improved automation and cross-functional collaboration.
- Successfully assume ownership of additional actuarial responsibilities, including reserve oversight and governance.
- Establish a clear long-term organizational vision for the actuarial function.

Long Term

- Build one of the industry's most modern actuarial organizations by combining deep actuarial science with AI-enabled decision support.
- Improve forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and enterprise decision-making through advanced analytics and automation.
- Develop a highly engaged, high-performing actuarial team that is recognized as a strategic partner across the organization.

You should get in touch if:

- You are a Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) and a Member of the American Academy of Actuaries.
- You have significant leadership experience in Medicare Advantage actuarial functions, including pricing, reserving, forecasting, and bid development.
- You are an AI evangelist and have demonstrated experience deploying AI workflows across your functional areas. Moreover, you are enthusiastic about applying automation and modern tooling to fundamentally improve the actuarial function.
- You have experience leading large, cross-functional initiatives that influence executive decision-making.
- You are equally comfortable discussing actuarial methodology with technical experts and communicating business implications to executives and non-technical stakeholders.
- You have a track record of building, mentoring, and developing high-performing actuarial teams.
- You thrive in fast-moving environments where you can build, innovate, and shape the future of an organization.

Benefits Overview:

- Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
- Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.

jobs.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:
Hims & Hers is at an inflection point. We've built dozens of categories that people love, and we're great at the treatments themselves. But today those are dozens of separate, transactional relationships. The opportunity in front of us is to invert that: to move from point solutions to one deepening relationship with each customer, where we understand them holistically across all of their concerns, help them navigate what to do, and let the individual treatments become secondary to the relationship itself.

That shift is what this role owns. It's a true 0-to-1 build, but not a cold start. You'll define a brand-new, relationship-first product experience that spans our existing categories and the new ones we create to support it, with everything we've already built as your foundation. Picture a concierge-style experience for the person who knows they don't feel their best, wants to feel better, and is looking for a trusted guide rather than another one-off transaction: lab testing, continuous care, and access to treatment, wrapped into one experience that compounds over time.

This is a rare seat. We're a company known for physical product and transactional care, making the leap to a sticky, engagement-driven, relationship-driven digital experience. Few established companies reach that moment, and fewer put a single person at the center of it. You'll work across the entire company to define what it looks like, and you'll do it on top of the AI infrastructure we're building, as someone who works that way themselves.

You Will:

-
Own the end-to-end consumer experience for this new relationship-first offering, from discovery and onboarding through ongoing engagement

-
Define the synthesis layer across our existing categories, and stand up the new product lines the offering needs

-
Partner with engineering and design to build AI into the core of the consumer experience

-
Partner with our clinical teams so protocols, safety, and education are core to the product experience

-
Shape short- and long-term roadmaps, driving long-term scalability while balancing day-to-day improvements

-
Operate with focus in a fast-growing, constantly evolving environment, where there are always more opportunities than resources

You Have:

6+ years of product management experience, working collaboratively across cross-functional teams

A track record of building and shipping consumer products that customers love and that drive meaningful business impact

-
A strong, specific point of view on where AI can meaningfully reshape the consumer healthcare experience, and the excitement to build it into the core of the product

Fluency with AI agents and AI-native workflows. AI-native is your default operating mode: you work with agents the way most PMs work with docs, fluently and constantly

Strategic and tactical range: you can set the vision and also design and execute scalable processes from scratch, ideally in an operations-intensive environment

Strong communication and a low-ego, high-EQ style. You build alignment, partner well across functions, and bring people with you. This is a fully remote role, so clear written communication and proactive collaboration matter

Bonus: experience in health, wellness, or category-defining 0-to-1 products

jobs.description:
Director, Influencer Strategy

LOCATION

The Director, Influencer Strategy position is a remote, work from home position, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. (a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, and conferences.

THE ROLE

Acceleration Partners is building out its influencer strategy discipline, and this role sits at the center of that effort. The Director, Influencer Strategy is a senior, externally-facing position responsible for shaping how AP goes to market with influencer programs. This person works at the intersection of sales, client services, and delivery, helping the business win new clients, build credible influencer strategies, and connect execution back to measurable outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings deep fluency in the brand-awareness and affiliate influencer space, strong business instincts, and the ability to work across internal teams to ensure that what we deliver compelling strategic programs that are successfully executed for our clients. A working knowledge of affiliate marketing is a plus; some learning curve on the affiliate side is expected and supported.

TOP 5 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

STRATEGY-LED SALES ENABLEMENT

Partners with the sales and delivery teams from the moment an opportunity comes in. Based on the prospect’s needs and goals, the Strategist owns building a credible, well-reasoned influencer strategy for proposals and RFPs. The Strategist will use thought-leadership and industry insights to define the appropriate creator strategy and the program’s direction – including audience insights, competitive analysis, creative positioning, influencer archetype creation, messaging frameworks, and platform recommendations. Works with delivery to ensure what is proposed is grounded in what can be delivered, budget, and scope. Joins pitch meetings alongside the sales lead and client services point person to speak to the strategy with authority and expertise. Answer client questions thoughtfully, showcasing a deep knowledge of the influencer space, examples of competitive programs, and creator best practices.

PROGRAM STRATEGY & INDUSTRY INTELLIGENCE

Define the strategy for robust, in-depth influencer programs grounded in industry research and competitive intelligence. Stays current on what brands across categories are doing in the influencer and affiliate space, tracking trends, emerging platforms, and talent ecosystems. Supports program launches and provides the strategic foundation that the delivery team executes against.

INDUSTRY LEADING REPORTING

Adds narrative and strategic context to reporting, connecting the dots between the strategy sold, the execution delivered, performance results, and forward-looking recommendations. Right now reporting is data-driven but lacks the strategic thread that ties it together. This role closes that gap and creates upsell opportunities in the process.

ONGOING CLIENT SUPPORT & UPSELL

Plugs in throughout the client lifecycle to provide strategic recommendations, industry thought-leadership, and pitching the strategy for expansion opportunities. Presents to clients alongside the delivery team on specialized program recommendations, optimizations, or expansions. Work on a diverse portfolio of brands, serving as a partner and resource to the delivery team and clients.

AP MARKETING & EXTERNAL PRESENCE

Contributes to AP’s external marketing through internal and external thought leadership. Opportunity to be featured in AP’s marketing efforts such as speaking at or attending conferences on influencer strategy topics. Helps build AP’s profile and credibility in the influencer space and inspire clients to believe in our strategic capabilities and knowledge base.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

BY 6 MONTHS...

You have a strong grasp of AP’s influencer offerings and sales process having contributed to multiple pitches. You are producing influencer strategy decks that the sales team is confident presenting to prospects. You have established working relationships with client services leads and understand how strategy translates into delivery. You are adding narrative context and future recommendations to client reports.

BY 1 YEAR...

You are a recognized internal resource for influencer strategy across the business. Your strategic program recommendations are being successfully delivered on with positive client feedback. The influencer pitch process runs more smoothly because of your involvement, and win rates on influencer opportunities are improving. Client reports have a cleaner strategic narrative and we see more clients opting into expansion opportunities. You are actively contributing to AP’s external presence through content or speaking, and you have identified and helped close at least one meaningful upsell opportunity.

QUALITIES OF THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

- Brings a clear strategic point of view and can defend it in a room with senior clients and leadership
- Equally comfortable building a deck and presenting it; thinks in narratives, but understands the tactics
- Collaborative by instinct; understands that the best outcomes come from working across and with teams
- Stays current on the influencer and creator space without being prompted; this is something they follow because they care about it in order to have a consistent pulse on the Influencer industry, brand activations, and social trends
- Can operate with autonomy, ambiguity and ownership in a discipline that is still being built out
- Reliable and able to effectively prioritize to hit deadlines
- Communicates with clarity and confidence, including with senior internal and external audiences
- Comfortable in a fast-paced, client-facing, agency environment working across multiple clients in different verticals

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

- 7+ years of experience in influencer marketing, with meaningful exposure to strategy, program buildout, or new business
- Demonstrated ability to build and present influencer strategies in a business development or client-facing context
- Deep knowledge of the influencer and creator ecosystem across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Substack, and emerging channels
- Working knowledge of affiliate marketing is a plus; willingness to learn is required
- Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to produce client-ready materials independently
- Ability to synthesize and visualize information effectively independently or in collaboration with Design
- Experience presenting to senior clients or speaking externally preferred
- Bachelors degree required
- Ability to travel as needed for client meetings, team gatherings, and industry conferences

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, AP’s global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that connect brands to the right consumers through affiliate and influencer All of our work is supported by APVision, our proprietary technology suite which leverages the largest dataset of any agency in the Partnership Marketing agency ecosystem. Serving over 200 brands—including household names like Amazon, Apple, Target, Google, Marriott, Coinbase, and Burberry—AP’s diversified team is creating what’s next in the industry by building high-performing partnership marketing programs. As the only truly integrated global partnerships agency, AP prides itself on being at the cutting edge of industry developments and leveraging proven expertise to deliver unique solutions for brands seeking sustainable growth.

AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER

- 100% remote work for everyone

- Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)

- 401K with matching

- Open Paid Time Off

- Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December

- Volunteer and Birthday Time Off

- Focus Fridays

- Paid Parental Leave Benefits

- Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances

- Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!

Target base salary is $110-130K + bonus depending on location and experience.

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual’s age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Telemedicine Physician Consultant
jobs.description:
About Carrot:


Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.


Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.


The Opportunity


Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time, fully remote physician consultants who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across multiple U.S. states. Depending on your licensure, certification, and area of expertise, you will provide consultations in menopause and perimenopause care aligned to The Menopause Society and ACOG guidelines, early fertility support aligned to ACOG and ASRM guidelines, or both.


Metabolic health is a core, cross-cutting component of this program. Weight, insulin resistance, and cardiometabolic risk are central to outcomes across every journey we support, from ovulatory function and preconception readiness to menopausal symptom burden and long-term cardiovascular and bone health. You should expect metabolic assessment and management to be a routine part of your visits, and clinicians comfortable prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists, within clinical protocols are especially encouraged to apply.


This is a flexible, part-time contractor engagement of approximately 5-40 hours per week, with a target commitment of 10-15 hours per week.


What You’ll Own


In this role, you will:



- Provide virtual consultations (video and/or phone) within your area(s) of expertise, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, and ongoing management of menopausal, fertility, and related hormonal and metabolic concerns.
- Apply current ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines with individualized, shared decision-making.
- Assess and manage metabolic health as a routine part of visits, including prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications such as GLP-1 receptor agonists within clinical protocols where appropriate.
- Document visits accurately and on time, order and interpret relevant labs, and coordinate referrals to primary care, OB/GYN, endocrinology, behavioral health, or subspecialists as needed.
- Maintain active, unrestricted multi-state clinical licensure, complete credentialing and payer enrollment, and maintain eligibility for additional state licenses to expand coverage.
- Contribute to member experience and quality through strong virtual visit presence, effective use of telehealth and EHR systems, participation in chart audits and case reviews, and staying current with emerging research and regulatory changes.

What Success Looks Like


In your first 12–18 months, you will have:



- Established a consistent panel of high-quality virtual visits within your clinical area(s), with strong member experience and visit quality results.
- Maintained timely, accurate documentation and lab follow-up, with no outstanding credentialing or compliance gaps.
- Expanded your state licensure coverage in line with program needs, supporting broader member access.
- Integrated metabolic assessment and management, including GLP-1 protocols where clinically appropriate, as a routine part of your visits.
- Contributed to chart audits, case reviews, and clinical protocol refinement as the telemedicine program scales.

About You ✨


You likely have:



- An MD or DO in Obstetrics/Gynecology, Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility (REI), Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Endocrinology; or you are a Physician Assistant (PA) or Advanced Practice Registered Nurse/Nurse Practitioner (e.g., WHNP, adult/gerontology NP, FNP) with demonstrated expertise in the applicable clinical area.
- A minimum of 3-5+ years of active clinical experience in early fertility support, menopause care, or both, including evaluation, treatment, and longitudinal management.
- An active, unrestricted U.S. medical license; multi-state licensure is preferred and IMLC participation is strongly preferred.
- For clinicians practicing in the menopause specialty: MSCP certification from The Menopause Society, or certification actively in progress with a clear completion plan.
- Familiarity with ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines.
- Prior telemedicine experience (preferred), with comfort managing visits entirely in a virtual environment and a strong virtual presence that supports shared decision-making over video and phone.
- Proficiency with telehealth technologies, including video platforms, secure messaging, electronic prescribing, and EHR/clinical documentation tools.
- Familiarity with HIPAA and applicable telemedicine privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, along with a HIPAA-compliant home workspace and reliable internet.

Nice to Have ⭐


While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:



- Clinical experience spanning both early fertility and menopause, enabling flexible coverage across member journeys.
- Experience working in a dedicated menopause clinic, fertility center, or comparable specialty program.
- Familiarity with early fertility workup, including AMH testing, ovulation induction, and preconception optimization, with appropriate escalation to in-person ART evaluation.
- Experience prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists (titration, side-effect management, monitoring, and discontinuation planning); obesity medicine training or ABOM certification is a significant advantage.
- Prior experience in digital health, health benefits, or multi-state telemedicine environments.
- Experience contributing to clinical protocol development, quality improvement, or member-facing clinical content.
- Experience supporting diverse and historically underserved populations, including LGBTQ+ and gender-diverse individuals.
- Fluency in an additional language.

Why This Role Matters


Carrot's telemedicine clinic is one of the most direct ways members experience our care. Every virtual visit shapes how members navigate some of the most personal moments of their lives, from trying to conceive to managing menopause. The clinicians in this network are the face of that experience, and the quality of their judgment, communication, and documentation determines whether members receive care they trust.


This role also anchors Carrot's clinical point of view that metabolic health is inseparable from reproductive and hormonal health. As the telemedicine program scales across states and journeys, the clinicians who join this network will directly expand access to guideline-aligned, whole-person care for members who often cannot find it locally.


Why Candidates Join Carrot 
Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.


Highlights include:



- A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
- A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
- Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
- Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
- Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
- A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
- The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:


Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $120-$160. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.


Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com


A Note on AI


At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.


For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.


Why Carrot?

We’re Looking For

- Fintech Expertise: Experience testing complex financial systems (card issuing, transaction processing, or credit risk).
- Automation Mastery: Hands-on experience with tools for UI (Playwright, Cypress) and API (REST Assured, Other API testing frameworks).
- Cloud & CI/CD: Familiarity with Azure, Git, and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows.
- Leadership: Ability to influence without authority, encouraging developers and POs to prioritise automation and quality.

Even if you don’t have all of the necessary skills, we still encourage you to apply.
