jobs.title: Product Lead (Strategy + Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Do you want to join the company behind Northern Europe’s largest crypto and stock market comparison platforms? Do you want to own the product roadmap end to end and build it yourself? Do you want to decide what we build next as we expand globally?

We’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead to join our small but driven 100% remote team. This is a rare hybrid role: roughly 60% product leadership (roadmap, prioritization, specs, analytics) and 40% full stack development. You’ll work alongside our full-stack web developer, and as we expand the Product Team, your focus will shift increasingly toward product and team leadership, running 1-on-1s, recruiting, and building your own team to improve our products, with a clear path toward Head of Product.

Who are Optimizee Group?

Optimizee Group has been delivering results for 450+ partners worldwide through financial comparison platforms since 2017. Our portfolio includes CryptoRunner.com (the largest cryptocurrency comparison platform in Northern Europe), InvestoRunner.com (the largest stock market comparison platform in Sweden), and CreditRunner.com (a new credit card comparison platform launching soon).

Our mission is to build the world’s biggest and most trusted portfolio of financial comparison platforms, helping millions of people make better financial decisions. To date, we’ve generated over 8 million views and delivered more than 1.8 million referrals to our partners. With approximately 44,000 monthly active users and 35,000+ subscribers, you’ll have a strong existing audience and foundation to build on.

In 2026, we relaunched our websites on fully custom-built platforms, replacing our previous WordPress setup (see full tech stack below). The new platforms are connected to our in-house admin system, with integrations to multiple AI models and third-party API providers, giving us greater flexibility, scalability, and control as we grow. AI is deeply integrated into the admin system and across development, content, and operations. Over the past year we’ve shipped 970+ updates, and our product backlog holds 350+ tasks. Your job: review our platforms and product backlog, decide what to prioritize, and turn ideas into new features — with direct support from the founder, a former web developer who built our first platforms line by line.

Why Join Optimizee Group:

- Be Part of a Market Leader – Help shape our established platforms, our group includes the largest stock and crypto comparison platforms in Northern Europe.
- Full Ownership, Real Impact – High autonomy, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to influence company decisions.
- Join Early, Grow Faster – Join a small, fast-growing team where your role, responsibilities, and opportunities grow alongside the company.
- Join an Ambitious Team – Work alongside high-performing teammates who value ownership, continuous improvement, and long-term thinking.

Benefits:

- 🚀 Clear path to Head of Product as the team scales
- 🤝 Work directly with the founder on strategy and growth
- ⏰ High autonomy, flexible working hours, and strong ownership
- 📈 Competitive compensation package + performance-based bonus
- 🌎 Fully remote role — work from most countries worldwide
- 🧰 All the AI and tools you need to do your best work
- 💻 Home office setup — laptop and required equipment provided
- ✈️ Annual business trips for team building, networking, and fun (past trips include Dubai, Singapore & Hong Kong)

Responsibilities:

- Own the product roadmap across our platforms — prioritize, spec, and drive execution from idea to launch
- Build and ship features hands-on alongside our web developer, improving site architecture, performance, and conversion flows
- Lead and grow the product team — manage team members, run 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and take part in recruitment as we scale
- Build our engineering workflow — set up development routines, code review, testing and deployment processes so multiple developers can ship safely, with documentation so knowledge is never siloed
- Make data-first decisions — turn user data, market insights, and analytics into actions that move traffic, conversion, and revenue per visitor

Requirements:

- 5+ years of full stack development experience — you can independently build, deploy, and maintain production web applications, and set up the workflows (Git, code review, CI/CD) for your team to do the same
- A track record you can show — live products, sites, or projects you’ve built or led, and the ability to walk us through the decisions behind them
- Strong backend, database, and architecture skills — data accuracy is critical to us, as we track and report statistics to 450+ partners
- Proven product ownership with commercial instincts — you’ve decided what to build, not just built what was decided, and you understand how those decisions translate into revenue
- Independent and async-first — you drive your own work in a small remote team and document decisions clearly in writing
- Genuine interest in cryptocurrencies, investing, and personal finance — and high standards for what a great comparison platform looks like

Tech Stack:

- Backend: PHP 8.2+ / Laravel 12 — one codebase powering the public sites and our in-house admin CMS/API
- Frontend: Server-rendered Laravel Blade with Alpine.js, Livewire (admin), Tailwind CSS, and Vite — no React/Next.js
- Database: MySQL, with Redis for cache, queues, and realtime (Laravel Reverb)
- Infrastructure: Linux VPS with Nginx and PHP-FPM, automated deploys via GitHub Actions
- Integrations: AI models via multiple providers (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) plus third-party API integrations powering our platforms and admin system

Our Team Values:

- Full Ownership – If you see it, you own it. Take full ownership from start to finish.
- Data First – Data first, decision second. Always put data first before making decisions.
- Long Game – We are building for decades, not quarters. Always play the long game.
- AI Speed – The fastest teams win. Use AI to move like a team ten times our size.

Location & Availability:

This is a fully remote position; however, candidates should be able to maintain reasonable overlap with European business hours (CET/CEST) for meetings and team collaboration. We welcome applications from candidates worldwide, except residents of the United States.

Compensation:

USD 48,000–90,000 gross per year, consisting of a fixed base salary (USD 48,000–60,000, based on experience) and a revenue-tied performance bonus. You’ll receive paid time off and public holidays in line with the standards of your country of employment. Additional benefits and reimbursements may apply depending on your location. We employ through a global HR partner, enabling compliant employment in 95+ countries.

Apply:

Send in your application here: https://forms.gle/4yqiWvhiCMnC6xdx7

Hiring process: 1-minute intro video → intro call with the founder → portfolio walkthrough → offer. Applications reviewed continuously, start date by agreement.

See all available jobs here: https://optimizeegroup.com/#jobs

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

We’re looking for an early-to-mid career Content Designer to join our Personalization team. You’ll help design personalized experiences that help people discover ideas they’ll love, while preserving the moments of serendipity that makes Pinterest unique. As a Content Designer II, you’ll work on surfaces like Homefeed to help users understand, navigate, and trust experiences that adapt to their interests, behaviors, and needs.

Content Designers at Pinterest are advocates for the user experience. We use language, information hierarchy, and content strategy to shape product experiences. The ideal candidate is a thoughtful content designer who understands how content can influence the direction of an experience, transform complexity into clarity, and create meaningful experiences at scale.

What you’ll do:

- Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, Research, Data Science, and more to shape personalized experiences across Pinterest, including Homefeed and other discovery surfaces.

- Apply content design, information design, and user-centered thinking to create and refine product experiences that help people discover ideas, understand recommendations, and engage with personalized experiences.

- Leverage research, data, and user insights to inform content decisions and identify opportunities to improve the Pinterest experience.

- Contribute to scalable content frameworks, patterns, and standards that help create clear, consistent, and trustworthy personalized experiences.

- Help create transparent, user-centered experiences by using language to explain why people are seeing content and how they can shape their experience.

- Explore and apply emerging AI tools and prompting approaches across the content design process (from discovery and concepting through evaluation and iteration) to improve decision quality, craft, and efficiency while applying strong content design judgment and user-centered thinking.

- Contribute to the broader Content Design practice by sharing learnings, evolving team best practices, and strengthening how we approach personalization at Pinterest.

What we’re looking for:

- 3+ years of experience in user-focused product content design, ideally with experience designing complex, data-informed, or personalized experiences.

- A Content Designer who goes beyond the string to help shape the content approach for a feature or experience.

- A collaborative partner who works effectively with cross-functional teams and brings a content design perspective grounded in user needs, clarity, and design principles.

- A portfolio demonstrating experience solving product problems through language, content strategy, and collaboration.

- A learner and builder mindset, with curiosity and willingness to explore emerging AI capabilities and apply them appropriately to content design workflows and product experiences.

jobs.title: Head of Operations - Shopify App Portfolio
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Victoria, British Columbia, Canada

URL: https://geoproapp.com

The opportunity

I'm looking for an experienced operator to take ownership of a portfolio of three established Shopify apps with a combined ARR of approximately $1.87M.

The portfolio includes:

- Geo:Pro: Geolocation-based storefront personalization
- TrackiPal: PayPal tracking automation for Shopify merchants
- Easy Lockdown: Content and storefront access control

Together, these are profitable, well-established products with engaged customer bases. They're not hypergrowth startups, but well-run businesses with clear opportunities to improve the product experience, strengthen operations and continue growing over time.

As the portfolio has grown, it's reached the point where I need an experienced operator to lead the day-to-day, keep the business running smoothly and turn strategy into execution.

The role is fully remote, async-friendly and suited to someone who enjoys ownership, autonomy and building well-run businesses.

What you'd own

- Team coordination and delivery: Run the day-to-day by coordinating the developer and tester through the full delivery cycle - from spec → build → ship → measure - keeping everyone aligned across time zones and hiring additional contractors as needed.
- Roadmap and prioritization: We'll set the roadmap together. I'll be closely involved at first, and over time this becomes increasingly your call. Turn Amplitude data, review themes and support signals into a prioritized backlog in Linear, and write clear tickets for the developer.
- Metrics and experimentation: Own the analytics story. Understand what moved, what didn't and what to try next. Design experiments and report on impact.
- Quality and documentation: Continually raise the bar on user experience through better documentation, smoother onboarding, fewer rough edges.
- Platform stewardship: Stay ahead of Shopify API changes, manage App Store compliance reviews and lead our annual Built for Shopify review to retain BFS status.
- Support oversight and escalations: Our support agency handles tier-1 tickets. You're the escalation point for product and engineering issues and own the agency relationship, ensuring response times, ticket quality and the merchant experience meet the bar.
- Shopify App Store Paid Ads: Oversee existing paid advertising campaigns, working with our marketing contractor to ensure everything runs smoothly. We'll set the marketing budget together each quarter, and you'll manage it.
- Shopify App Store rankings: Monitor Shopify App Store rankings across the portfolio, identify opportunities to improve rankings and respond quickly when rankings decline.

What you don't have to do

- Write code (there's a developer for that)
- Do QA (there's a tester for that)
- Handle routine support tickets (an agency handles that)
- Respond to reviews (a contractor handles that)
- Fundraise, hire executives, sit in stakeholder meetings or manage political overhead - none of that exists here

Growth areas we've already identified

- Easy Lockdown: Shift to usage-based pricing
- Geo:Pro + Easy Lockdown: Onboarding and activation optimization
- Geo:Pro + Easy Lockdown: Feature gaps that address missing customer use cases
- All three apps: Lift review ratings to improve organic App Store rankings

You're not walking into a blank page - there's already a clear direction, but plenty of room to test your own ideas.

What you'll be walking into

- Small, remote team: You'll be coordinating a small team of contractors working across different time zones, so communication and keeping work moving are a big part of the role.
- Established products: The apps are profitable and well established, but some of the codebases are older and occasionally require pragmatic workarounds rather than perfect solutions.
- Data-driven decisions: Our analytics stack is solid (Amplitude, BigQuery, Shopify Partners)  - SQL fluency, or comfort writing it with AI help, is required.

How we'll work together

- Founder involvement: I've run these apps alongside another business and know them inside out. I'll stay focused on product direction, strategy, quarterly planning and major decisions while you run the day-to-day.
- Working rhythm: We'll meet weekly at first while we build context and alignment, then move to monthly strategy check-ins and quarterly planning sessions. Beyond that, you'll have the autonomy to run with it.

Who you are

- Strong operator: You've successfully run product or delivery for a small SaaS team. Background isn't important - results are.
- Technically fluent: You can write clear product specs, understand trade-offs and weigh development estimates without needing to review code.
- Organized and proactive: You enjoy coordinating people, removing blockers and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.
- Data-driven: You use Amplitude, SQL and customer feedback to inform decisions.
- Self-directed: You're comfortable working asynchronously, managing your own priorities and taking ownership without constant direction.
- Bonus: Experience in the Shopify ecosystem, App Store Optimization (ASO), paid acquisition or SaaS growth.

Where this could go

This isn't a role with a fixed ceiling. As you build context, take on more responsibility and the portfolio grows, there's scope for the role to grow too. Exactly what that looks like will depend on the business and the impact you have, but the door is genuinely open.

Role details

- Time: Part-time, approximately 15-25 hours per week
- Compensation: US$65-$85/hour, depending on experience
- Employment: Contractor or employee - whichever works best for you
- Location: Fully remote, async-friendly, any timezone

jobs.description:
The Problem36 million businesses in America need insurance—it's not optional. 77% are underinsured. 40% have no coverage at all. The distribution system failed them: too slow, too opaque, too confusing.

Over 90% of commercial insurance is still human-led. We're building the inverse: 90%+ AI-led, pushing toward the higher 90s. Not by patching legacy workflows—by building AI that makes humans more effective, improves the customer experience, and eliminates friction at every step.

We're adding ~1,000 customers per month. We've grown 100x since last year. We're looking to do even more this year—and that's why we're hiring.

You'll build the team and the systems the rest of engineering depends on. When they compound, everyone gets faster.

The ThesisHarper runs 200+ services across Railway and AWS. We orchestrate N parallel agentic workloads. Our AI systems make thousands of decisions a day, and every decision needs to be traceable, evaluated, and cheaper to run tomorrow than it is today. The infrastructure underneath all of that is the difference between a company that scales and one that stalls.

Great platform engineering here isn't invisible—it's the reason product ships fast. When observability catches a silent failure before a customer does. When a pooling layer makes connection exhaustion a non-issue. When developer velocity doubles because someone built the tool nobody knew they needed. That leverage compounds across every other engineer on the team.

The RoleThis role is open both to an experienced EM and to someone on the path to becoming an EM who doesn't yet have significant management experience—we're happy to bring that person on and support the transition.

This is a team that still needs to be built. We have 2 people in it today, and we believe this area needs significant investment at Harper. The role owns three things: infrastructure (cloud, third-party vendors, and everything surrounding it), developer productivity (making sure we're genuinely an AI-first shop, with the right AI tooling and harnesses in place for every other engineering team to be successful), and SRE and production support (production discipline is top of mind as we head into a high-growth, high-scale phase—we need someone who has run an SRE function before). Each of these three areas can grow into a larger team of its own over time.

The team is 2 people today, growing to five to six over the next three months. Because the team is small, whoever takes this role—EM or TLM—will need to be hands-on at the start, working directly with the team and doing the work themselves.

What You'll Do- Own infrastructure — cloud, third-party vendors, and everything surrounding it

- Build developer productivity — the AI tooling and harnesses that make every other engineering team genuinely AI-first

- Own SRE and production support — bring production discipline as we head into a high-growth, high-scale phase

- You've been a line manager for at least two years, directly managing teams of six to ten people—or you're on a clear path there and want to grow into it

Nice to Have- Your own network to draw on for hiring—otherwise, comfort working closely with recruiters

jobs.title: Membership Coordinator
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States

URL: https://coaching.com

Membership Coordinator
GENERAL INFORMATION

Department

Membership

Reporting to

Membership Manager & Director

Start Date

Immediate

Salary

US$28,000.00/annually

IS THIS YOU?

-
Do your friends and family consistently come to you for advice on organization?

-
When going on a road trip, are you the one with the directions, playlist, and backup plan ready in the passenger seat?

-
Do your friends make fun of you for your checklists, color-coded calendars, or goal-tracking obsession?

-
Is Mel Robins at the top of your podcast playlist?

-
Do micro-managers give you the ick?

-
Are you the friend who remembers birthdays, sends thoughtful follow-up messages, and keeps everyone in the loop?

-
Are you the person who reads the entire instruction manual before assembling something, then teaches everyone else how to do it?

-
Have people in your life been mildly annoyed with you because of your incessant follow-up and “just confirming” messages?

-
Have you ever caught an error in a shared document that everyone else missed?

-
Do you get a little bothered when files are saved in the wrong folder or named inconsistently?

-
Are you looking for a company that acknowledges your independence and rewards you accordingly?

ROLE PURPOSE
We are a global educational company, and our mission is to harness the power of coaching worldwide. We achieve this through our Coaching Enablement Platform, offering a comprehensive suite of services designed to support and accelerate coaches' development. Our services include the Coaching Center of Excellence (a hub for professional development and education), Coaching Management Software, and Coaching Marketplace. Through these platforms, we empower coaches to shape their skills and have a profound impact on human life.

As a Membership Coordinator, you will play a vital role in managing and coordinating various aspects of our membership programs and community engagement initiatives. This role is ideal for a proactive, confident and detail-oriented individual who is passionate about supporting professional development and fostering a sense of community among our members.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:
Within the first 90 days, the Membership Coordinator will:

-
Deliver recurring membership communications, reminders, session logistics, and follow-ups accurately and on schedule.

-
Maintain timely, transparent communication with members, facilitators, speakers, and Membership team.

-
Ensure all session links, registration/access settings, automations, and resources are tested before they are shared externally.

-
Maintain complete, accurate, and accessible program records, reports, and SOPs.

-
Proactively flag risks, blockers, unclear ownership, or missed deadlines before they affect members or facilitators.

-
Establish a clear, consistent operating rhythm so the Membership Manager and Director always have visibility into progress and confidence that work is complete and accurate.

RESPONSIBILITIES
The Membership Coordinator reports directly to the Membership Manager & Membership Director to support the delivery training and education to our Members.

Your main responsibility is to support, coordinate and execute membership delivery administrative tasks, ensuring agreed program milestones are met. The role also has a specific focus on managing volunteer facilitators, hosting and providing technical support on live sessions, and coordinating the monthly newsletter.

-
Membership Project Management:

-
Own the day-to-day coordination of assigned membership programs, projects, communications, and recurring administrative workflows.

-
Build, maintain, and update project plans, task lists, deadlines, owners, dependencies, and status updates in Asana.

-
Ensure every assigned task has a clear owner, deadline, intended outcome, and documented completion status.

-
Provide daily updates on weekly priorities, progress, risks, blockers, and next steps in the designated Membership team channel or project-management system.

-
Schedule meetings; prepare agendas, materials, and links; capture decisions and action items; and distribute follow-up notes promptly.

-
Maintain an accurate membership operations calendar covering sessions, facilitator commitments, speaker commitments, member communications, reminders, deadlines, and follow-up requirements.

-
Identify repetitive manual work and recommend or implement approved automations to improve accuracy, timeliness, and efficiency.

-
Membership Delivery:

-
Collaborate with the Membership Team on delivery, design & development processes.

-
Acknowledge all member, facilitator, speaker, and internal emails within 24–48 business hours, even when a full resolution requires more time.

-
Escalate sensitive member issues, complaints, refund/payment concerns, access problems, or unresolved requests to the Membership Manager promptly.

-
Coordinate the operational delivery of membership sessions, coaching circles, learning experiences, workshops, and summits.

-
Complete quality assurance before any member-facing launch or send, including testing registration links, access permissions, invite links, reminders, automations, quiz links, recordings, and resource downloads in a test account where applicable.

-
Coordinate and compile new member and cancellation data, ensuring timely and relevant information is shared across teams.

-
Support the delivery of live membership sessions on Zoom, including session support, session hosting, logistical coordination, scheduling and content preparation.

-
Upload, title, tag, and publish recordings and resources in the Membership Resource and Recording Library in Circle according to established standards.

-
Update SOPs promptly whenever a workflow, platform, automation, communication sequence, or ownership model changes.

-
Assist with general administrative tasks related to membership management, including summit coordination, member database maintenance, and documentation.

-
Hosting coverage when needed.

-
Facilitator Coordination:

-
Manage and coordinate volunteer facilitators, allocating sessions, being their point of contact and ensuring they are well-prepared for the sessions they are facilitating.

-
Maintain complete facilitator records, including session assignment, attendance, feedback, completed reports, outstanding actions, and follow-up needs.

-
Collect, review, and file session and facilitator reports for completeness, accuracy, and required follow-up before closing them.

-
Speaker Coordination:

-
Support the Membership Director with speaker research, outreach, booking, scheduling, confirmation, preparation, and post-event follow-up.

-
Send and track speaker invitations, calendar holds, confirmation emails, reminder emails, asset requests, biographies, headshots, slides, workbooks, and handouts.

-
Ensure speaker materials meet our standards before publication and are stored in the correct central location.

-
Coordinate collection of testimonials, speaker thank-yous, post-session feedback, and all required follow-up communications.

KEY COMPETENCIES
Ownership and follow-through

You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. You close loops, verify delivery, track follow-up, and do not consider work complete until the intended result has been achieved.

You’re proactive

You keep the team informed without being asked. You surface risks early, seek clarification, communicate delays immediately, and propose a recovery plan when a problem arises.

Detail and quality orientation

You are meticulous with links, access, dates, time zones, lists, group assignments, reports, and member communications. You use checklists and testing to prevent avoidable errors.

Member and stakeholder care

You communicate with warmth, professionalism, and urgency. You understand that incomplete follow-up, missed reminders, or unclear information can damage a member’s or facilitator’s experience.

Adaptability

You can handle shifting priorities while protecting critical recurring work. You know how to distinguish urgent tasks from important tasks and ask for direction when priorities conflict.

Confidence in live settings

You are comfortable hosting and supporting online sessions, communicating calmly in front of groups, solving basic technical issues, and representing us professionally.

BENEFITS

-
Flexible working hours, with at least 50% overlap with Eastern Time / New York business hours.

-
Fully remote work environment.

-
Access to our events, training, and expert-led learning experiences.

-
Annual professional-development plan and training budget.

-
Unlimited Time Off, subject to advance coordination and continued coverage of critical member-facing responsibilities.

-
Opportunity to work in a mission-driven, creative, collaborative, global team.

HOW TO APPLY
Please fill out this  APPLICATION FORM, following the instructions outlined.

In this application, you’ll do the following:

-
Fill out basic information.

-
Upload your resume/CV.

-
Submit a cover video describing why you would like to work with us, and what specifically qualifies you for this position. This video should range between 2-3 minutes.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/coaching-com-membership-coordinator-1

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote • Anywhere

About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)
Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

- Predictable performance, even at scale
- Secure, compliant environments by default
- Real-time observability and profiling built in
- Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
- AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values:

 We make a positive impact.

 We aim for the stars.

 We care for each other.

Impact of a Billing Systems Architect
As an Enterprise Billing Systems Architect at Upsun, you are the technical anchor of our billing infrastructure, playing a vital role in ensuring our revenue operations, pricing structures, and financial integrations run seamlessly as our business scales. Picking up primary ownership from our implementation partner, you serve as the dedicated technical lead bridging Finance, Product, and Engineering.

You’re deeply analytical, systems-minded, and collaborative—someone who thrives on translating complex business, pricing, and accounting rules into reliable system logic. Working downstream from our core engineering and data mediation teams, you ensure the integrity of our Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) platform while continuously optimizing platform performance and automation.

Beyond day-to-day platform administration, you contribute to the long-term evolution of our billing architecture—supporting new pricing model launches, complex usage rating schemes, and financial system integrations. Your attention to detail, technical versatility, and cross-functional mindset ensure our revenue pipeline remains scalable, compliant, and friction-free.

What to expect

-
Billing Infrastructure & Administration: Serve as the hands-on technical owner of our BillingPlatform environment, configuring catalogs, price cards, usage rating rules, and automated invoice schedules.

-
System Operations & Maintenance: Own ongoing platform health, including system updates, pricing launches, recurring bill-run troubleshooting, sync exception handling, and root-cause issue resolution.

-
Data Ingestion & Analysis: Utilize SQL to perform data validation, rating engine auditing, and operational reporting while collaborating with Engineering to receive mediated usage data (e.g., via DigitalRoute or Kafka).

-
Integrations & API Management: Maintain and optimize clean, API-driven integrations connecting BillingPlatform to upstream CRMs (e.g. Salesforce), downstream ERP/GL tools (e.g., NetSuite), and payment gateways (e.g., Stripe).

-
Revenue Recognition Alignment: Partner closely with Accounting to ensure system rating rules, revenue schedules, and general ledger mappings satisfy ASC 606 and IFRS 15 compliance standards.

-
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Gather technical and operational requirements directly from Accounting, Finance, Sales Ops, and Product teams, translating their vision into sustainable platform configuration.

-
Data Integrity & Migration: Maintain billing data continuity and manage subscription data updates or migrations without disrupting ongoing financial operations or revenue recognition flows.

What you bring

-
Q2C Platform Experience: Proven hands-on experience configuring and administering enterprise Quote-to-Cash or billing platforms (e.g., Zuora, Salesforce Revenue Cloud/CPQ, NetSuite Billing, Aria Systems, or BillingPlatform).

-
Data & Technical Skills: Strong proficiency with SQL for querying and auditing billing data, alongside a solid grasp of REST APIs, webhooks, and ETL workflows.

-
Modern Pricing Expertise: Experience supporting complex SaaS or infrastructure pricing models—such as PLG, hybrid commitment-plus-usage, tiered rates, and consumption-based/metered billing.

-
Revenue Recognition Knowledge: Practical understanding of rev rec fundamentals (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) and how accounting rules dictate billing engine design.

-
Cross-Functional Communication: Ability to bridge technical language and financial business logic, effectively collaborating with engineering teams and accounting stakeholders alike.

-
Problem Solving & Troubleshooting: A methodical approach to diagnosing system sync errors, rating anomalies, and integration edge cases to ensure operational continuity.

Bonus points

-
Experience with DigitalRoute mediation software or Kafka event-stream data intake

-
Previous exposure to cloud infrastructure, PaaS, or developer-platform usage metrics

-
Background supporting system migrations from implementation partners into internal teams

Where we hire
At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

How we hire
We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.

You can expect 5 video interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment.

- 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition
- 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Senior Director, FP&A and IT)
- 60 Minutes with Team (Engineering team)
- 60 Minutes with Team (Finance team)

- 45 Minutes with Executive (CFO)

All roles require background checks.

What we offer
 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.

 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

 Flexible PTO

 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

 Company stock options

 Professional development budget

 Office equipment budget

‍️ Wellness budget

 Annual team gatherings

 Internet reimbursement

 Inclusive parental leave

️ Remote work travel program

You belong here
At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, Canada

** Open to remote within the East Coast only**

At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?

If you love working with brilliant people, being part of an energetic team, changing the world of software and you’ve got the technical skills, you might be the perfect Frog to join our Swamp! Come and join the Professional Services team and help us to continue to lead the rapidly evolving space of DevOps and DevSecOps!

As a Senior Professional Services DevOps Engineer in JFrog you will...

- Work with JFrog customers to design, setup and build CI/CD pipelines and DevOps platform using JFrog products and other cutting edge technologies and practices like Docker, Kubernetes, IaC and Cloud Native
- Team up with Sales, Customer Success, Support and Development while work directly with Devs and DevOps Pros to ensure success with the customer’s DevOps journey using the JFrog platform
- Setup, design and build CI pipelines with Docker, NPM, Java, Pypi etc.. (Binary Repositories, Distribution to Devices and Continuous Build Tooling)
- Train the open source community and JFrog customers
- Influence the features and roadmap of JFrog tools based on customer needs
- Keep current with the latest technology trends related to DevOps and the landscape of CI/CD Technology
- Work closely with our customers and community to build solid relationships

To be a Senior Professional Services DevOps Engineer in JFrog you need...

- 7+ years experience with Continuous Integration tools: CI Server, Git, Artifactory, Jenkins, Maven, Docker, NPM
- Ability to build software delivery pipelines with Docker, npm, Java, Pypi etc.. with various DevOps tools such as Git, Binary repositories management, Binary scanning, and Continuous integration
- Good understanding of infrastructure & operations - storage, network, computer, security, cloud (public, on-prem)
- Experience with Continuous Deployment and Delivery tools: Chef, Puppet, Ansible, Kubernetes
- Hands on experience in Linux - Mandatory
- Hands on experience with cloud infrastructure - AWS / Azure / GCP - Mandatory
- Experience with customer facing with great interpersonal and customer service oriented skills
- Experience with server side software on-premise and in the cloud
- Experience with Software Architecture design and product development a plus
- Uncompromising will to learn
- Open Source state-of-mind

WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…

- Open to remote work for candidates outside a reasonable commuting distance to the Atlanta office.
- At JFrog, base salary is only one component of our compensation package.
- This position has a base salary range between $130,000 to $150,000 CAD.  Base salary will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and location.
- Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments.
- This position also includes an equity package of restricted stock units (RSU).  In addition, JFrog employees are eligible to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
- JFrog provides employees comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement, wellness and much more!

JFrog is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.

jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description:
Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr

NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce.

Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that.

The Social Comms role: We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment.

As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one. 

The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public.

You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work.

You'd be a great fit if

- You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious.- You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have.
- You've run or grown popular social accounts before.- You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you.- You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about.- You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included.- You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time.- You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits.Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks.

The Role:

 

We are looking for a Senior SAP S/4HANA Developer on behalf of our client to lead backend and full-stack development within a modern S/4HANA enterprise landscape. In this role, you will take technical ownership of designing, building, and extending mission-critical SAP applications—leveraging modern development paradigms such as the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and Core Data Services (CDS).

You will drive modern, upgrade-stable SAP development by adhering strictly to "Clean Core" architectural guidelines. Rather than relying on legacy, modification-heavy ABAP patterns, you will build side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP, expose optimized OData services, push heavy calculations down to the in-memory SAP HANA database, and deliver intuitive user experiences via SAP Fiori.

 

What we’re looking for:

 

-
5+ years of SAP development experience, with at least 3 years dedicated to S/4HANA, featuring expert command of Object-Oriented ABAP (OO-ABAP), New ABAP Syntax (7.4+), and RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model).

-
Advanced proficiency authoring complex Core Data Services (CDS) Views, parameters, associations, access controls (DCL), and ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP) for code push-down performance.

-
Extensive experience creating and exposing OData v2/v4 services via SAP Gateway (SEGW) or RAP business services for UI consumption and third-party cloud integrations.

-
Practical experience developing custom SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications or configuring Fiori Elements apps using CDS annotations.

-
Firm understanding of modern SAP extensibility frameworks, including On-Stack Developer Extensibility (Embedded ABAP / Steampunk) and Side-by-Side Extensibility using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

-
Proven ability to trace, profile, and optimize ABAP/HANA execution using Runtime Analysis (SAT), ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC), SQL Trace (ST05), and SQL Monitor (SQLM).

 

Nice-to-have skills:

 

-
Hands-on experience developing side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP using Node.js/CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) or ABAP Cloud.

-
Background in legacy-to-S/4HANA code remediation, custom code analysis (CCA), and migration projects.

-
Exposure to Event-Driven Architecture using SAP Event Mesh or Kafka integrations.

-
Knowledge of standard SAP S/4HANA business process modules (FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP).

 

Responsibilities:

 

-
Architect, build, and maintain high-performing transactional and analytical SAP applications using ABAP RAP, CDS views, and AMDP.

-
Build upgrade-stable enhancements and side-by-side extensions, strictly minimizing legacy modifications to protect core system stability.

-
Design and expose secure OData endpoints to power SAP Fiori user interfaces, mobile apps, and enterprise cloud integrations.

-
Perform automated code checks (ATC), enforce clean code standards, conduct peer code reviews, and optimize legacy custom code for S/4HANA compatibility.

-
Collaborate closely with SAP functional consultants, enterprise architects, and BTP specialists to translate business requirements into technical solution specifications.

jobs.title: Director of Production Engineering
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

Director of Production Engineering
Remote, United States
About this Position

Are you passionate about building the reliability, automation, and security foundations that let engineering teams move fast with confidence? At Legion, we are seeking a Director of Engineering, DevOps & SRE to lead the teams responsible for the availability, scalability, and security of our production environment. Our production infrastructure runs on AWS, leveraging services such as EKS, RDS, and a broad set of AWS-native technologies. You will partner closely with engineering and IT to build resilient systems, drive operational excellence, and ensure our platform meets the highest standards of security and compliance.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll spend ~20-30% of your time contributing directly to architecture, tooling, and incident response, and the rest driving vision, roadmap, and cross-team execution.

Responsibilities

- Hire and build a globally-distributed DevOps/SRE engineering team. Recruit, mentor, and manage engineers, and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
- Own the reliability and infrastructure roadmap for our AWS-based production environment, including EKS, RDS, and related AWS services, ensuring scalability, high availability, and cost efficiency.
- Lead the organization's security operations (SecOps) practice, including vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, and remediation, to proactively identify and resolve security issues before they impact customers.
- Define and drive engineering OKRs for infrastructure reliability, automation, and security, and track progress against measurable outcomes.
- Champion observability and alerting best practices (e.g., Datadog), including automating alert triage and response to reduce mean-time-to-resolution.
- Solid understanding of agentic AI infrastructure and how AI agentic workflows apply to SDLC and DevOps processes (e.g., automated investigation, remediation, and PR-generation pipelines).
- Drive Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, and automation practices to increase engineering velocity and reduce operational toil.
- Work closely with engineering and IT teams to align on infrastructure standards, access controls, tooling, and compliance requirements across the organization.
- Ensure the platform meets the highest standards of security, compliance, and data protection; implement and maintain robust security controls and audit-readiness.
- Lead and participate in the Incident Management on-call rotation, working with SRE and development teams to meet and exceed availability goals.
- Stay current on cloud, DevOps, and security best practices, and provide technical guidance and thought leadership to the broader engineering organization.

Required Qualifications

- 8-12 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or production infrastructure roles, including people management experience.
- Deep hands-on experience running production workloads on AWS, including EKS (Kubernetes), RDS, and other core AWS services (e.g., VPC, IAM, Lambda, S3).
- Demonstrated experience running security operations (SecOps) — vulnerability management, incident response, and remediation of production security issues.
- 5+ years of experience leveraging observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana) to drive reliability, performance, and alerting improvements.
- Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) and CI/CD automation.
- Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or Bash, with day-to-day use of Git and test automation pipelines.
- Hands-on experience operating Linux/Unix production platforms (Amazon Linux, Ubuntu, RHEL/CentOS).
- Proven track record partnering cross-functionally with engineering and IT teams to align on infrastructure, tooling, and security standards.
- Demonstrated experience leading incident management and on-call practices for high-availability production systems.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required; Master's degree preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with major cloud providers beyond AWS, such as Google Cloud Platform or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
- Relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, AWS Security Specialty, CKS).
- Experience with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA.
- 3+ years of experience with Kubernetes or other containerization/orchestration platforms at scale.
- Experience with Kubernetes-native delivery tooling, including Argo Workflows and Helm.
- 5+ years of experience leading teams in an agile/scrum environment.
- Experience building or scaling automated investigation and remediation pipelines for production error classes.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Salary Range: Base Salary Range  $220,000 - $265,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and the internal equity for the same position within the company.

Benefits include, but are not limited to:

- $0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment
- 401k plan
- Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
- Parental Leave
- Equity
- Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
- Monthly Lunch on Legion

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.

Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees.  Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

For more information, visit https://legion.co

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION

For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @legion.co domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion.co

jobs.title: Senior SRE - Networks
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United Kingdom (Remote)

Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

Senior SRE - Networks

Fastly’s Technical Operations (TechOps) team is responsible for building & operating the infrastructure that powers the Fastly Edge Cloud Platform. We oversee an extensive global network that spans 6 continents with over 100 points of presence and 578 Tbps of connected capacity.  Our platform serves a significant portion of the content delivered to internet consumers across the planet, with customers ranging from online media streaming services to e-commerce, to open source projects, nonprofits and more. We take this responsibility seriously!

We’re looking for an experienced SRE with strong focus on Networks, SRE principals and knowledge of the internet who can bring engineering best practices, operational rigour, and automation skills to help craft the future of Fastly’s network and directly contribute to making the internet better.

What You'll Do:

-
Build, operate, and maintain the continually growing global network footprint of Fastly’s Edge Cloud Platform.

-
Response to significant traffic incidents and lead network incidents, resolving edge cases and failure scenarios with your expertise in IP routing, particularly BGP.

-
Write code that is performant, maintainable, clear, and concise and contribute to code reviews, improving the codebase and other team processes

-
Partner in the development and iteration of tools and automation systems that improve how we operate and build the network.

-
Innovate new methods for monitoring network performance, focusing on the end-user experience, and proactively address potential issues.

-
Continual deep-dive of performance-based analytics and close involvement with partner teams to maintain a performant global network.

-
Advocate for the operational stability of the network by identifying opportunities and partnering with engineering teams to shape their roadmaps and software solutions.

-
Mentor team members on the complexities of global routing, especially in an anycast-heavy environment.

What We're Looking For:

-
Experience in the protocols and practices that make up the fabric of the global internet, including TCP/IP, BGP, Anycast and DNS.

-
Experience in Automation and coding using languages like Python, or similar.

-
Proficiency in Tier 1 Internet service providers, Internet exchanges and cloud providers.

-
Ability to analyze internet traffic patterns across multiple dimensions using flow-based tools.

-
Experience working with alerting, monitoring and visibility tools (such as Graphite/Grafana, Prometheus, or Splunk).

-
Knowledge across cloud hosting solutions (i.e., GCP, AWS and Azure).

-
Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI / CD pipelines (ie. Git, Jenkins, Ansible).

-
Understanding of Linux/Unix systems administration and network stack optimisation.

-
Adept at knowledge sharing and creating comprehensive documentation to empower teams.

-
Able to collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape the technical roadmap, prioritizing initiatives to optimize automation tooling and the network.

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:

-
Experience writing production-level code using VCL or GO

-
Experience in network telemetry including instrumenting infrastructure and collecting, processing, storing and analyzing data

-
Experience working with geographically dispersed teams: previous remote work preferred

Work Hours:

-
This position will require you to work during scheduled hours from 0800 - 1700.

-
This position will require you to be available during core business hours.

-
It may also require occasional nights and weekends as necessary to support any on-call coverage.

Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements:

Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home. This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager.

This position has one opening and can be hired in the following locations:

-
London (Hybrid)

- UK, Remote

Benefits:

We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings?

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet your needs. Our offerings may vary depending on the country where you work and are subject to change.

Why Fastly?

We have a huge impact. Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives. Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand.

We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful -- every day.

We are passionate. Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about.

We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply! A fully completed application and resume or CV are required when applying.

All job applications must be submitted through our official careers site at www.fastly.com/about/careers.
